action.command: cd /workspace && SID=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8090/api/session | grep -o '"uuid":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4); echo "SID=$SID"; UP=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8090/api/upload_file -H "X-Session-ID: $SID" -F "file=@tests/data/test10sec.wav"); JOB=$(echo "$UP" | grep -o '"uuid":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4); echo "JOB=$JOB"; curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8090/api/transcribe -H "X-Session-ID: $SID" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"uuid\":\"$JOB\",\"diarize\":false}"; echo; echo "$SID" > /tmp/sid2; echo "$JOB" > /tmp/job2
